Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the separation principle by claiming a screen filter can separate magnetic from non-magnetic materials (filters separate by size, not magnetism) and also mislabeled the option, stating “C) a screen filter.” The correct tool is a horseshoe magnet (option C), which attracts steel but not aluminum.
